svg.title: SimPaths UK model structure
svg.desc: Conceptual annual module cycle. The wealth module includes housing, private pensions, other assets and debt. The macro module distinguishes long term growth from short term fluctuations. Purple dashed outlines indicate components under development: short term fluctuations, other well-being outcomes, inter-vivos transfers and pension-rule imputation. Long term growth uses external economic assumptions. Circles group processes; arrows do not specify the exact execution schedule.
